boundaries: Non-object payload/event, non-list events, empty/nonstring id

"events": [{"id": nonempty_string, "value": any_JSON_value}, ...]}.
Every event must contain both id and value. Booleans are invalid capacities.

Output records contain only id and value; extra input keys are ignored.
Reject malformed records/containers with ValueError. Input values may be null.

requirements.statement: Accept objects with nonnegative integer capacity (excluding bool) and a list of records containing a nonempty string id and a value; allow null/any JSON value and extra object keys, and reject malformed records or containers with ValueError.

boundaries: Existing ID updated when at capacity
Reinsert an evicted ID at the newest position
requirements.oracle: For capacity 2 and a1,b2,a3,c4, final items are b2,c4 and evicted is [a]. Promoting a would instead evict b.
requirements.planned_evidence: Public check index 0 and explicit FIFO update/reinsertion unit tests

source_refs.quote:
Update an existing ID in its original insertion position, without promoting it.
When inserting a new ID would exceed capacity, evict the oldest resident ID.

requirements.statement: Update resident IDs in their original insertion position without promotion; new IDs evict the oldest resident when capacity would be exceeded.

requirements.oracle: Zero capacity with a1,a2,b3 yields empty items and [a,a,b]; a set of evictions or retained zero-capacity item would falsify this.
requirements.planned_evidence: Explicit output assertions in unittest cases

source_refs.quote:
Capacity zero immediately evicts EVERY event. Return {"items": [final records
in FIFO order], "evicted": [IDs in eviction order, retaining repetitions]}.
Output records contain only id and value; extra input keys are ignored.

requirements.statement: Return final items in FIFO order with only id/value and all evicted IDs in chronological order retaining repetitions; capacity zero immediately evicts every event.
